284433951.description:
Rock & Mineral Specimen Collection Lot
Mixed Geological Assortment
Polished Agate, Geodes, Tumbled Stones, Rough Minerals & Educational Kit
This diverse geological collection features a broad variety of natural rock and mineral specimens suitable for collectors, lapidary enthusiasts, display, or educational study. The assortment encompasses cut and polished lapidary agates, crystalline geodes, natural rough quartz chunks, tumbled gemstones, and an encased identification rock kit.
Four polished natural agate slice coasters with visible concentric banding and rough edges
Two open crystalline quartz geode halves and one cut polished pink agate slab
Labeled educational rock collection tray containing 15 identified mineral and rock specimens
Large assortment of polished tumbled gemstones including tiger's eye, jasper, aventurine, and amethyst
Large bag of raw mineral chunks including rough rose quartz, clear quartz, and mixed field stones
Wire-wrapped stone pendant and small bagged rainbow moonstone specimen
Condition:
Overall very good condition. Polished agate slices and slabs display clean faces with natural outer rind texture. Geodes feature intact crystalline cavities with no major fractures. Tumbled stones show smooth polished surfaces. Educational kit remains sealed in plastic wrap with some outer plastic wear. Natural inclusions, pitting, and rough edges are inherent to geological specimens.
